annotations.title: Get a build packet (Replace with AI)

description: Use when the user wants to replace a tool by building their own (Replace with AI): returns SPEC.md, AGENTS.md and the runbook files a coding agent builds from, for a recipe with a build path. A recipe without one returns the assessment files for validating a switch or downgrade instead, never a spec to clone a service. Check packet_kind and next_step before acting. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses). Tool results are summarized; exit tools log only result counts, qualification flags and public evidence statuses, not answer contents. Don't send personal data or secrets.
